original.prompt: Consider the following statements about municipal bonds in India, as reported in May 2026:
items: Indian municipal bonds had raised only INR 45 billion over the previous nine years.
The government is offering 2% interest subsidies to encourage municipal bond issues.
The government is offering incentives of INR 10 billion for large municipal bond issues.
original.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
original.explain: The incentive for large issues is INR 1 billion (USD 10 million), not INR 10 billion. The incentive is meant to revive a stagnant market that raised only INR 45 billion in nine years. Regulators are also tightening disclosure rules because investors worry about opaque local accounting.
original.source: the government is offering INR 1 billion (USD 10 million) incentives for large issues and 2% interest subsidies
